transport_retry.rule: At most one blind retry of the identical request, only when no answer arrived: a connection error, a timeout, or HTTP 503 after a one-second wait. Never after any answer, even an empty or malformed one, and never for other HTTP statuses, authentication, configuration or model-identity failures. The retry is charged in model calls, tokens and dollars before it is sent, from unreserved campaign capacity only; if the budget cannot cover it the original failure stands. It never uses an actor turn or a discovery request. A second failure ends the work as before.

stop_rules: product ends itself on NO_CHANGE/COMPLETED/ERROR/STOPPED; watcher stops on: discovery accounting (used_calls > 160 or charged > 4.27 dollars before any post-discovery state), disk < 2 GiB, 6 hours; operator stops on world-integrity failure, two consecutive LAB_ERROR, auth/config/frozen-model failure, source drift.
